items.summary: Click here for more articles by Kormedi.com. Bell peppers do more than add vibrant colors and a satisfying crunch to dishes such as salads and japchae, a Korean stir-fried glass noodle dish. Their colors also offer clues to the nutrients they contain, with each variety providing different nutritional benefits. From vitamin A precursors that support vision in dim light to compounds that help protect the retina and vitamin C that improves iron absorption, the nutritional profiles of bell peppers vary depending on their color. So which color should you choose, and how can you get the most out of its nutrients? Red bell peppers: Beta-carotene supports vision in low light Red bell peppers are rich in beta-carotene, a pigment that the body can convert into vitamin A. According to comparative data released by Korea's Rural Development Administration, red bell peppers had the highest beta-carotene content among the four colors examined. Beta-carotene is a naturally occurring pigment responsible for the yellow and orange hues of many fruits and vegetables. Beyond giving produce its color, some of th

items.summary: The ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) is expected to initiate a parliamentary motion to impeach the Supreme Court chief justice on Dec. 3, the second anniversary of ousted former President Yoon Suk Yeol's 2024 martial law bid, the party's spokesman said Saturday. Rep. Cho Gye-won, the spokesman, made the remark a day after the DPK made an official decision to seek the impeachment of Supreme Court Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae over its accusation that the top court complied with Yoon's martial law declaration, its decision to send President Lee Jae Myung's election law case back to the appeals court and other reasons. Though no official decision or discussions have been made, Rep. Cho said there appears to be a tacit "consensus" in the party about initiating the motion on Dec. 3, a point in time that he said can "demonstrate a firm determination to root out the insurrection."

It added that, besides the resident registration for locals, there are other means through which foreign residents can have their residence in Incheon officially verified. items.title: Freight train derails near Sejong, leaving Saemaeul, Mugunghwa services suspended
items.title_zh: 货运列车在世宗附近脱轨，导致新村号、无穷花号列车服务暂停
items.summary: PYEONGTAEK/SEJONG — Five cars of a freight train derailed near the central administrative city of Sejong early Saturday, leaving Saemaeul and Mugunghwa train services between the cities of Daejeon and Cheonan suspended. High-speed KTX services were unaffected, and no human casualties were reported. The 21-car train went off the rails after an automatic emergency brake system activated as it entered Sojeong-ri Station in Sejong, some 120 kilometers south of Seoul, at 5:37 a.m. When the train went off the tracks, it hit and broke a steel support pole, snapping the overhead power lines and causing a power outage between Cheonan and Jeonui stations. The accident initially delayed Saemaeul and Mugunghwa passenger trains before services were suspended. KTX bullet trains, which run on separate tracks, were not affected. Korea Railroad Corp. (KORAIL) said it will use buses to transport passengers over the suspended section so that they can change trains to their ultimate destinations. KORAIL plans to look into what caused the derailment as soon as services return to normal.

Under an expanded municipal trial unveiled recently, Gangnam District is deploying artificial intelligence (AI)-powered robots across five everyday civic roles — patrolling parks for fire hazards, clearing lunch trays at a senior center and assisting street sweepers with heavy lifting. The program transforms the bustling urban district into a live testing ground for Korean robotics startups eager to prove their machines can survive the unpredictability of real city streets. The initiative underscores a wider national push across Korea, which already leads the world in industrial robot density — with more than 1,000 robots per 10,000 manufacturing workers — and is now racing to bring automation out of factories and into daily life. items.title: Coalition launches major military operation to neutralize Houthi threats against Saudi Arabia
items.title_zh: 联军发起大规模军事行动，以消除胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯的威胁
items.summary: RIYADH — The Joint Forces Command of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen launched on Friday a military operation to neutralize sources of threat used by the Houthi terrorist militia to target civilians in Saudi Arabia and Yemen, including vital facilities supporting its military activities.The coalition said the operation targeted Houthi military capabilities and infrastructure involved in weapons smuggling and transportation, adding that operations were continuing against military targets in the governorates of Sanaa, Saada and Taiz.The coalition announced the destruction of seven legitimate military targets that had been designated for military use and supporting the Houthis’ military activities.It also confirmed the destruction of six workshops used by the militia to support its military capabilities.The coalition said its operations in Sanaa focused on destroying and neutralizing sources of threat to prevent attacks against civilians in Saudi Arabia and Yemen.It also announced the neutralization of one of the Houthi terrorist militia’s main supply facilities in Sanaa.The Joint Forces Command had earlier called on civilians to evacuate the port of Hodeidah in accordance with an accompanying map to ensure their safety.

items.title: ZATCA foils six attempts to smuggle over 2.3 million amphetamine pills through Duba Port
items.title_zh: ZATCA挫败了六起企图通过杜巴港走私230多万粒安非他明药片的行为
items.summary: RIYADH — Saudi customs authorities at Duba Port have foiled six attempts to smuggle more than 2.3 million amphetamine pills concealed in shipments arriving in the Kingdom through the port.Hamoud Al-Harbi, spokesperson for the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA), said six trucks arrived in the Kingdom through Duba Port carrying shipments of concrete bricks.The narcotics were discovered concealed inside the hollow cavities of the bricks during customs inspections using advanced security technologies and detection dogs.Al-Harbi said that following the seizures, the authority coordinated with the General Directorate of Narcotics Control (GDNC) to apprehend the intended recipient of the narcotics inside the Kingdom, resulting in his arrest.He reaffirmed ZATCA's commitment to tightening customs controls over the Kingdom's imports and exports across all customs ports and combating smuggling attempts.Al-Harbi emphasized that these efforts are in line with one of the authority's key strategic objectives of enhancing security and protecting society by preventing the smuggling of narcotics and other prohibited substances.He added that the authority continues to carry out its duties in close coordination and cooperation with its partners at the Ministry of Interior and the General Directorate of Narcotics Control.

items.title: Japan plans to offer Saudi Arabia 16 million barrels of additional oil storage, buy up to 8 million barrels
items.title_zh: 日本计划向沙特阿拉伯提供1600万桶额外石油储存，并购买多达800万桶石油
items.summary: RIYADH — Japan intends to provide Saudi Arabia with an additional 16 million barrels of crude oil storage capacity and purchase up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude for its national reserves, Saudi Press Agency reported on Friday.The announcement came following a virtual meeting between Saudi Minister of Energy and Minister of Industry and Mineral Resources Prince Abdulaziz bin Salman and Japanese Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Ryosei Akazawa on Nov. 9, 2026.During the meeting, the two ministers reaffirmed the strong and longstanding strategic partnership between Saudi Arabia and Japan and discussed ways to further strengthen bilateral cooperation, particularly in the energy sector.Following discussions within the joint task force established in May 2026, Saudi Arabia reaffirmed that it regards Japan as a strategic partner and attaches great importance to supporting its long-term energy security through stable and reliable crude oil supplies.Japan expressed its deep appreciation to Saudi Arabia for its continued provision of stable and reliable crude oil supplies.The Kingdom has already begun replenishing joint oil stockpiling tanks in Japan.Recognizing the longstanding importance of the Joint Crude Oil Stockpiling Project, established in 2010, and its recently demonstrated effectiveness, Japan intends to make an additional 16 million barrels of crude oil storage capacity available to Saudi Arabia for a limited period through its national stockpiling facilities.The additional capacity would bring the total storage capacity available to the Kingdom under the arrangement to 24 million barrels, including the existing capacity of 8 million barrels.Japan also intends to purchase up to 8 million barrels of Saudi crude oil for its national stockpile reserves, subject to favorable market conditions and the completion of necessary internal procedures.The two countries will also cooperate under Japan's "POWERR Asia" initiative to enhance energy security across Asia, building on the AZEC Ministerial Work Programme for Strengthening Oil Stockpiling presented at the ministerial meeting on Oct. 8.The program outlines future measures to develop institutional frameworks and infrastructure for oil stockpiling across Asia, strengthen cooperation with oil-producing countries and coordinate emergency responses.The two ministers welcomed the continued engagement between Saudi Arabia and Japan and expressed their shared aspiration to further strengthen their strategic energy partnership.Both ministries will continue discussions to explore additional opportunities for energy cooperation, enhance the existing joint crude oil stockpiling scheme and maximize its potential.

items.title: Saudi Arabia reserves legitimate right to defend its territory, people and national interests: Al-Khuraiji
items.title_zh: 库赖吉：沙特阿拉伯保留捍卫其领土、人民和国家利益的合法权利
items.summary: NAPLES — Saudi Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Waleed Al-Khuraiji reaffirmed that the Kingdom reserves its legitimate right to defend its territory, people and national interests in accordance with international law.His remarks came during a session titled "Securing Strategic Chokepoints and Rethinking Maritime Security" on Thursday, held on the sidelines of the Mediterranean Dialogues (MED) conference in Naples, Italy.Al-Khuraiji said recent developments in maritime corridors underscore the close interconnectedness between maritime security, regional stability and global prosperity.He noted that the security of strategic waterways, from the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab Strait to the Strait of Hormuz, is a matter of international concern.He emphasized that protecting strategic maritime corridors remains a fundamental priority that requires effective regional and international cooperation.The deputy minister stressed the importance of focusing on diplomatic efforts, de-escalation and addressing the root causes of regional instability to ensure that vital waterways remain safe and open in accordance with international law.On Yemen, Al-Khuraiji reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's continued commitment to achieving security and prosperity in the country.He also stressed the importance of confronting any attempts to use Yemeni territory to threaten neighboring countries or international navigation.

items.title: Riyadh hosts Ethnosport Cultural Festival for first time outside Türkiye
items.title_zh: 利雅得首次在土耳其境外举办民族体育文化节
items.summary: RIYADH — The Ethnosport Cultural Festival opened on Thursday at New Murabba in Riyadh, marking the first time the international festival has been held outside Türkiye, with more than 18 countries showcasing 38 traditional sports and games.The opening ceremony was attended by General Entertainment Authority (GEA) Chairman Turki Alalshikh, World Ethnosport Confederation President Necmeddin Bilal Erdoğan, dignitaries, representatives of participating countries and sports federations, and guests from around the world.Hosted as part of Riyadh Season, the festival brings together hundreds of athletes, artists and artisans to celebrate traditional sports, cultural heritage and shared human values.In his opening address, Alalshikh expressed his gratitude to the Saudi leadership for its unlimited support for the entertainment sector and Riyadh Season.He welcomed the opportunity to host the festival for the first time outside Türkiye, describing it as an international event that brings nations together and celebrates their sporting and cultural heritage.Alalshikh said Riyadh Season, now in its seventh edition, continues to attract major international events and offer diverse experiences.He noted that since its launch in 2019, Riyadh Season has sought to diversify its offerings across various fields, with the Ethnosport Cultural Festival representing an extension of that approach.He highlighted the partnership with the World Ethnosport Confederation, which was announced in Istanbul last September, saying the festival in Riyadh represents the outcome of that cooperation.Alalshikh also announced that the partnership would continue next year, with Riyadh Season sponsoring the 2027 edition of the festival in Istanbul.He expressed hope that hosting the event in Riyadh would pave the way for further cooperation with the confederation, promoting traditional sports, preserving their heritage and passing them on to future generations.For his part, Erdoğan expressed delight at holding the festival in Saudi Arabia for the first time, describing the occasion as a historic milestone for the World Ethnosport Confederation.He said the confederation had long aspired to take the festival to different parts of the world after completing eight editions in Istanbul, adding that hosting the event in Riyadh fulfilled one of those ambitions.Erdoğan noted that the confederation currently comprises 56 member institutions from 34 countries across five continents.He said the organization works with its members to revive and preserve traditional sports and games, pass them on to future generations, and strengthen friendship, peace and solidarity among nations.The festival brings together hundreds of participants from around the world to celebrate their cultural heritage and share their traditions with others, Erdoğan said.He explained that the program caters to visitors of all ages, combining traditional sports and games with arts, handicrafts and diverse cuisines that reflect humanity's shared cultural heritage.Erdoğan emphasized the importance of preserving cultural roots and historical ties between communities, praising Riyadh's exceptional organization and hospitality.He expressed confidence that the 10-day festival would create memorable experiences for participants and visitors while opening new avenues for cooperation between Saudi Arabia and Türkiye in preserving and promoting traditional sports.The opening ceremony featured a grand artistic and cultural performance, beginning with a parade of participating delegations led by the Saudi team.The performance showcased the sporting and cultural heritage of participating nations through displays highlighting traditional skills, arts and practices passed down through generations.Ahead of the opening ceremony, Alalshikh and Erdoğan toured the festival grounds, reviewing its facilities and the sporting, cultural and heritage experiences offered by participating countries.Running through Nov. 28, the Ethnosport Cultural Festival features traditional wrestling, equestrian sports, archery, folk and intellectual games, handicraft workshops and folkloric performances.Dedicated interactive areas for children and families also offer visitors opportunities to discover and participate in traditional sports and games.The festival welcomes visitors daily from 5 p.m. to midnight at New Murabba in Riyadh, with tickets available through the Webook platform.

items.title: Saudi Arabia warns against exploitation of natural resources to finance violence and prolong conflicts
items.title_zh: 沙特阿拉伯警告不要利用自然资源资助暴力和延长冲突
items.summary: NEW YORK — Saudi Arabia has warned against the exploitation of natural resources to finance violence and prolong conflicts, calling for intensified international cooperation to combat illicit trade in these resources and protect energy facilities, maritime corridors and supply chains.The remarks were made by Acting Chargé d'Affaires of Saudi Arabia's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York Fares Al-Otaibi during a UN Security Council session on natural resources and conflicts.Saudi Arabia stressed the importance of respecting countries' sovereignty over their natural resources and strengthening transparency and accountability to ensure that their revenues benefit their people.The Kingdom pointed out that Houthi attacks on oil facilities have disrupted Yemen's exports and deprived the Yemeni people of vital economic resources.Saudi Arabia also highlighted its efforts under Saudi Vision 2030 to promote sustainable resource management and economic diversification.The Kingdom emphasized the importance of international partnerships in addressing the root causes of conflicts and promoting stability.

items.title: Riyadh ranks first globally in UN Local Online Services Index with perfect score
items.title_zh: 利雅得在联合国地方在线服务指数中以满分排名全球第一
items.summary: RIYADH — Riyadh has ranked first globally in the United Nations Local Online Services Index (LOSI) in the 2026 UN report, which assessed cities across 194 countries.The Saudi capital achieved a perfect score of 100% across all assessment categories, advancing from third place in the 2024 rankings.Riyadh Municipality contributed to this achievement by advancing its digital services across the index's six key areas: digital services, digital content, institutional framework, digital literacy, infrastructure and digital participation.Riyadh's global leadership in the index also reflects the progress achieved under the Riyadh Municipal Transformation Program, which aims to deliver comprehensive digital transformation through high-quality, resident-centric services.The program seeks to enhance residents' quality of life through advanced smart services that meet their daily needs and aspirations, further cementing Riyadh's position among the world's leading cities in digital governance.

items.title: Saudi Education Minister witnesses signing of 9 cooperation agreements with US universities and companies
items.title_zh: 沙特教育部长见证与美国大学和公司签署9项合作协议
items.summary: WASHINGTON — Saudi Minister of Education Yousef bin Abdullah Al-Benyan witnessed the signing of nine bilateral cooperation agreements between Saudi educational entities and American universities, institutions and companies during his official visit to the United States. The agreements focus on educational technologies, curricula and digital content, aiming to develop educational tools and resources, leverage international expertise and improve the quality of education and learning outcomes. **media[2797132]** The agreements include cooperation between the Council of Universities' Affairs and Gallaudet University, which specializes in educating students with hearing disabilities, to develop academic and specialized programs, advance scientific research and joint studies, train personnel and exchange expertise. Al-Benyan also witnessed agreements between Princess Nourah bint Abdulrahman University and Educational Testing Service (ETS), Maarif for Education and Google, and Maarif for Education and National Geographic. Another agreement was signed between Tatweer Educational Technologies Company (TETCO) and Google and Cisco, while Tatweer Education Company signed agreements with Savvas, McGraw Hill and National Geographic to develop curricula and educational content. **media[2797133]** The partnerships cover specialized education, assessment and evaluation, the integration of modern technologies into education, and the development of digital solutions and educational resources to enrich curricula and improve the learning experience. They also aim to leverage international expertise in developing educational tools, platforms and resources while strengthening technological and educational cooperation between Saudi institutions and global partners. The agreements support the Ministry of Education's efforts to accelerate digital transformation, advance curricula and educational content, and expand the use of modern technologies and innovation to improve educational practices. **media[2797134]**

items.title: Coalition intercepts five drones, one ballistic missile as Civil Defense issues alerts in Asir, Jazan
items.title_zh: 联军拦截五架无人机和一枚弹道导弹，民防部门在阿西尔和吉赞发布警报
items.summary: RIYADH — The Coalition to Support Legitimacy in Yemen announced that five drones and one ballistic missile launched by the terrorist Houthi militia had been intercepted and destroyed on Friday, as Civil Defense issued emergency warnings in parts of the Asir and Jazan regions. Early Friday morning, Coalition spokesperson Maj. Gen. Turki Al-Malki confirmed the interception and destruction of a drone launched by the Houthi militia toward Saudi Arabia’s southern region. The Coalition subsequently announced the interception and destruction of another drone launched toward the same region. Later that morning, Al-Malki announced that air defenses had intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched toward the southern region. The Coalition then confirmed the interception and destruction of a third drone launched toward the same region. In its latest announcement, the Coalition confirmed that two additional drones had been intercepted and destroyed in the Riyadh and southern regions. Meanwhile, the General Directorate of Civil Defense issued warnings through the National Early Warning Platform for Emergencies in Jazan city, as well as Abha and Khamis Mushait in the Asir region. The first warning was announced early Friday morning in Jazan city, followed by separate warnings in Abha and Khamis Mushait later that morning, alerting residents to potential danger. Civil Defense urged residents receiving emergency alerts to remain calm, follow official instructions and immediately seek shelter in the nearest safe location, preferably inside a building or an interior room away from windows. The authority also advised residents to remain indoors until the danger had passed, avoid open areas and potentially dangerous locations, and follow instructions issued through official channels. Civil Defense further urged the public to report emergencies by calling 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and the Eastern Province, or 998 in other parts of the Kingdom.

items.title: Orange alerts issued for heavy weather in Jazan, Makkah and Asir as thunderstorms continue across Saudi Arabia
items.title_zh: 随着雷暴天气在沙特阿拉伯各地持续，吉赞、麦加和阿西尔发布了恶劣天气橙色预警
items.summary: JEDDAH — The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) has issued orange alerts for moderate rainfall in parts of Jazan, Makkah and Asir regions on Friday as thunderstorms and rainfall continue across several parts of Saudi Arabia. The orange alerts are in effect from 5 a.m. to 5 p.m., with the NCM warning of strong winds, near-zero horizontal visibility, hail, flash floods, high waves and lightning. According to the NCM's nationwide weather forecast, moderate to heavy thunderstorms accompanied by active winds and hail are expected to continue across parts of Asir region, potentially triggering flash floods. Meanwhile, light to moderate rainfall is forecast across parts of Jazan, Al-Baha and Makkah regions. Fog may also form in parts of these regions, as well as the Eastern Province, while weather conditions are expected to remain stable across the rest of the Kingdom.
